html: The Swiss official looked anything but neutral as he cost England a place in the semi-final.The referee was in exactly the right place to get a view as Sol Campbell thumped a header onto the bar.The Arsenal man followed up and nodded home from close range, but Meier ruled out the 90th minute effort.Meier appeared to indicate that John Terry has pushed goalkeeper Ricardo, but there was little evidence of significant contact.
